name: 53713 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53713 (Madison) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53713 (Madison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53713 (Madison) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
